reframing_rationale: Both MICROBIOME and METABOLOME representations already run through the identical prespecified nested-CV, decision-score-ranking, source-cross-fitted-threshold, and 2000-resample bootstrap protocol on matched participants with reciprocal external validation (see run_stage4b_corrected_v2b.py: REPRESENTATIONS loop treats both symmetrically). 'Co-primary' does not mean identically interpretable: metabolomics retains an explicit cross-assay quantitative-scale caveat that microbiome composition does not, because HMDB feature-identity matching does not establish common units, response factors, or upstream transformations across cohorts.

MICROBIOME.external_interpretation_scope: cross-cohort transportability of harmonised genus composition

METABOLOME.external_interpretation_scope: cross-cohort reproducibility/transportability of the matched metabolomic representation under the supplied cohort-specific processed matrices; cross-assay quantitative equivalence was not established (HMDB matching gives feature identity, not common units, response factors, or upstream transformations)

EARLY_INTEGRATION.external_interpretation_scope: whether combining the two co-primary molecular layers improves on either single-omic representation
